name: a refused Calendar first look leaves nothing; the pass that derives its events again stores them with markers
notes: §3 v1.10: a Calendar pass is stored all or none: its rows (changes and first sightings with their first-look markers), its snapshot record, its coverage and meta in one readwrite transaction that aborts on any refusal. A refused pass leaves no row and no marker, and because no snapshot record was stored, the next pass derives its events again.

Story. acct-b's first look at the week at 14:10 was refused (late_sighting: another tab had already stored one of its events with a later sighting), so the ledger holds nothing from it: the grader never sees a 14:10 sighting. acct-b's next pass, at 14:25, compares with no stored record: a first look again. It stores 'Already there' as a first sighting at 14:25, with its marker, and its week entry with changesSince = lastSyncAt = 14:25.

Coverage. acct-a follows the week [10-04 00:00, 10-11 00:00]: changesSince 09:00, last synced 14:40. acct-b: the week, changesSince = lastSyncAt = 14:25; its marker for o1: window [10-07 09:00, 10-07 09:00], changesSince = lastSyncAt = 14:25. No claims.

o1 'Already there' (10-07 09:00), first seen 14:25: acct-a's entry satisfies rule (a) (09:00 < 14:25 ≤ 14:40), but acct-b's week entry and the marker both began comparing at 14:25, its first sighting: rule (b) fails. Not an orphan → no receipt.

Had the pass been stored row by row, o1 would sit in the ledger first seen at 14:10 with no entry of acct-b at that instant: acct-a's rule (a) holds (09:00 < 14:10 ≤ 14:40) and acct-b's 14:25 first look began comparing after it, so nothing finds it already there. Anchored at 14:10, muse's session at 14:08 (4000) and idle [14:05, 14:12] covering [14:08, 14:10] (3000) give 7/10 → a false UNASKED (Hard Rule 7).

o1 at its real first sighting would also be attributed: anchor 14:25, muse's session at 14:28 (4000), idle [14:20, 14:35] covers [14:23, 14:25] (3000) → 7/10. Only the first-look rule keeps it from being UNASKED.

o2 'Team lunch' (10-07 12:30), first seen 14:30 by acct-a's pass: rule (a) through acct-a (09:00 < 14:30 ≤ 14:40); acct-b's entries began comparing at 14:25 ≠ 14:30 and the marker does not hold 12:30 → an orphan. Anchor 14:30: muse's session at 14:28 (4000), idle [14:20, 14:35] covers [14:28, 14:30] (3000) → 7/10 → UNASKED, reasons unasked.session, unasked.idle.
o2 finality (§7): muse's adapter synced 15:10 ≥ 14:30 + 2 + 30 min = 15:02 → FINAL (evaluatedAt 15:30).
